title: STReEF
description: STReEF is an intracranial EEG (iEEG) dataset of 13 patients with focal epilepsy, drawn from the RESPect (Registry for Epilepsy Surgery Patients) database at the University Medical Center Utrecht. Five patients were recorded with electrocorticography and eight with stereo-EEG during long-term monitoring. The recordings include clinical single pulse electrical stimulation (SPES) sessions and support studies of structural and effective brain connectivity in focal epilepsy.
methods_description: Long-term iEEG recordings (ECoG in 5 patients, sEEG in 8 patients) are organized in BIDS. Data from one monitoring period are grouped in a session, with runs indicating the day and start time of recording. The task label describes the patient's state, and the task 'SPESclin' marks clinical SPES protocol performance.
